# Dave Martis
## Dave Martis
### Signature
**David A. Martis** is a Hot Wheels designer, modelmaker, and prototyper who worked with Mattel from 1999 to late 2004 as a senior project designer and model maker. Known for his work on Mechanix , Robo Wheels , Gyro Jets , IR Rally , and 1/64 scale Disney/Pixar Cars prototypes, he preferred casting and hand painting “B-grade” resins using clay, SLA 3D prints, and existing parts from around the model shop as the process was “quicker and easier” than sketching concept art.

...

In years prior Martis designed bikes for GT Bicycles and automotive accessories for Powers Design International. After his tenure he worked at fellow toy company Playmates for a year, later founding his own company, Devium Design.

...
